raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/FloatingCo: Agent completion presentation now follows the canonical terminal lifecycle used by PTT and chat.

The live-suggestion notch card and the hover shortcut legend are distinct assistantId/overlay branches alongside the existing reach-error and notch-moment cards; the legend's own view lives in NotchSystemControlsView.swift rather than here.

Reusing the existing owner-scoped, TTL-bounded notification store to hand the last notch card to a voice follow-up needs a read-only accessor and a shared builder here; the builder also carries the untrusted-context framing, since a card's body and provenance are assembled from screen OCR and memories.

DEBUG owner-boundary tests need a capture-free effect-handler install seam; shared ensureAutomationBarConfigured() removes duplicated automation setup while adding that seam (BasedHardware/omi#10499). Setup and both PTT entry points then warm the CoreAudio input-routing snapshot off the main thread so turn start never reads the HAL inline (BasedHardware/omi#10442).
Adds bounded realtime mint-failure outcome correlation and close-resolution telemetry so release health distinguishes started recovery from exhaustion; telemetry-only, no lifecycle change (#10425).

Strict concurrency annotations (Ticket 14) add Sendable conformances and isolation qualifiers; sendBackgroundAgentContext confirms the provider send before returning true (exactly-once: no ack before delivery), the session emits hubDidOpenInputWindow so a warm-idle completion is retried, and URLSession is invalidated on transport teardown via an explicit backing optional to break the delegate retain cycle — all beside the file-private send/turn machinery.
